title: The Paired Bell Course
summary: A school course in bells rung in pairs that closes on the twin carillon where two peals become one stroke.

title: Manual of the Azure Court Chord
summary: A school manual of the court chord whose voices answer and resolve and that ends in the sovereign chord of the azure court.

title: Hawk's Highest Cry Course
summary: A school course in the highest and thinnest cry of the hawk that ends in the cry that splits the sky itself.

title: Canon of the Basin and River Resonance
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on the resonance that gathers like a basin and runs like a river and in the end floods.

title: The Wind-Sworn Voice Course
summary: A school course in the sworn voice of the Gale academies that ends in the oathcall which rouses the wind to answer.

title: Manual of the Plateau Drum
summary: A school manual of the drum beaten on the open plateau whose rolling rhythm rallies friends and ends in a cadence of ruin.

title: Treatise on the Open Bearing Hum
summary: A school treatise on a hum held on a taken bearing through the open field that ends in the resonance that fixes the foe to that bearing.

title: Canon of the Unwalled Last Silence
summary: A school canon for those with a formed Core on a silence without walls that mends in its calm and ends in the last silence that stills a field.
